words.meaning: A screen of charts and numbers that updates itself from the data.
To post a report so its readers can open it. Unpublish takes it down.
When a dashboard loads the newest data from its source.
A copy of data saved out of a system into a file.
A person who misses a booked visit without canceling.
A second record for the same person or thing.
To join two or more records into one record.
A set of slides for a talk or meeting.
To hide real names and details by swapping in made-up ones.
A small set taken from all the data. Sample size is how many are in it.
A saved question to a database. It returns the matching rows.
A number far from the others in a set of data.
The middle number when all the numbers are put in order.
The written list of what a new system or report must do.
The owner's written OK that a piece of work is final.
Customer relationship management. The system that keeps client contacts and their history.
When an email comes back because the address does not work.
A best guess about future numbers, based on past data.
Key performance indicator. A key number a team watches closely.
A table that groups and adds up rows of data, like totals by month.
A person who cares about a project or is affected by it.
A written request to change work that was already agreed.
The person in charge of a set of data. They decide who may see it.
The list of saved versions of a file, with dates and authors.
Vice president. A senior leader who runs one part of the company.
